Page 122

When separated, heart and body of Ril - cendrées are elusive to all our graspes other than through thought though still fruits of Siwômiz, but they become graspable when reunited into one whole - into Ril - cendrées - appearing to us then as an infinitesimal dust of their so rich true constitution, itself extremely fleeing to our gazes.

  • Thus the RILIE ( Magic / Unexplained Phenomena / Mediators of Actions - at - Distance ), these riches or assemblies as if coming from a breath or nod, or again what appears born from nothing like one of the seventy - two Zimwis and thus what we call the fantasy and magic of the world, seems to surge like simple dust but in ravenous and sudden floods of that same dust with entrails so full, illuminating everyone's imagination in its possible powers.
